definitions.explanation: Food that is raw or barely processed and goes off quickly, such as fresh fish, raw meat or cream cakes. Common on labels and gift notices ({生物|なまもの}につき、お{早|はや}めにお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりください).

examples.japanese: {生物|なまもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生物|なまもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}み→傷む：10061_itamu⟧やすい。
examples.english: In summer, perishable food goes off easily.

examples.japanese: {生物|なまもの}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧、⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧し、⟦{本日中|ほんじつちゅう}→本日中：22830_honjitsuchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり→お召し上がり：26515_omeshiagari⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This is a perishable item: please keep it refrigerated and eat it today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧や⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生物|なまもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You cannot put perishables such as meat or fruit in a parcel going abroad.

notes:
Also written {生|なま}もの, which avoids confusion with {生物|せいぶつ} (living thing). The reading is clear from context: labels, gifts and food talk mean なまもの.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {生物|なまもの}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧: as this is perishable (on labels)
- {生物|なまもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: perishable, so no returns
- {生物|なまもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: not good with raw food

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生物|せいぶつ}: living thing, organism — same kanji, different word
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: sashimi — one kind of raw food
